name: InterContinental Osaka
positioning: A luxury city hotel steps from Osaka station, with skyline views, rooms that blend contemporary elegance with Japanese culture, and a spa floor with an indoor pool and a traditional Japanese bathhouse
best_for: Travelers who want a base steps from Osaka station for day trips to Kyoto, Kobe and Nara
Families or longer stays wanting a Residence with a fully equipped kitchen
Guests who value a club lounge and a spa, pool and bathhouse after a day of sightseeing

facts.text: The hotel is located in one of Osaka's most vibrant dining and shopping destinations.
The hotel is located steps from Osaka station.
The hotel is ideally placed for day trips to Kyoto, Kobe and Nara.
The Classic room is designed with a blend of contemporary elegance and elements from Japanese culture.
The Classic room has a spacious marble bathroom with a separate bath and rain shower, plus a walk-in wardrobe.
The swimming pool is a 20-meter indoor lap pool with an indoor jet bath, free of charge to all hotel guests.
The dedicated Spa and Fitness floor has a fitness gym open 24/7 with a private exercise room and stretching area, and training attire is available free of charge.
Club InterContinental provides personalised hospitality from a dedicated concierge.
The 3-60 lounge serves afternoon tea featuring the hotel's own TWG Tea blend, in a setting adorned with fine artwork.
The hotel is named a Michelin One Key hotel for 2026.

highlights.text: Guests can unwind at the spa, indoor pool, jet bath and sauna, and a traditional Japanese bathhouse.
Accommodations overlook views of the glittering city skyline.
The one, two and three bedroom Residences include a fully equipped kitchen with microwave, espresso machine, refrigerator, freezer and dishwasher.
The Club InterContinental Lounge on the 28th floor offers breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails and canapes.
Pierre received a one-star rating in The Michelin Guide 2026 and serves seasonal dishes in refined French cooking styles.

considerations.text: Kansai International Airport is about 51 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
